title: Shot and reverse at matched angles
purpose: Two shots of the same conversation from opposite sides, both from the same height, so the cut between them reads as one room rather than two.
keeps: the angle on both sides, because it is arithmetic on the plate and not a request
the place, since a reverse is another plate of the same place
cannot: the eyeline (nothing here measures who is looking at whom)
the angle in a place with no straight verticals
measured: the angle pass delivers to 0.04 of what is asked on any readable place, so two shots asked for the same angle land within 0.08 of each other
hint: Two shots of the same conversation from opposite sides, both from the same height, so the cut between them reads as one room rather than two.
